The depositor states separate code and data licences. The provider is Khalzan, Tsolmon; Sereeter, Batmunkh. Coverage: The application is Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, with three heat sources, 25 substations and 68 candidate corridors. The reference period and numerical time resolution are not established. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it supports reproduction of network-design and single-contingency comparisons.
